title: Extract synthetic ticket IDs with regex
system_prompt: You are a coding assistant. Return correct Python 3 code in one fenced code block.
user_prompt: Implement extract_ticket_ids(text: str) -> list[str] for tokens matching TCK-[0-9]{4}.

expected_behaviors.description: Uses re module with pattern matching TCK-####.

prohibited_behaviors.description: Returns hardcoded IDs instead of parsing input text.

objective_checks.description: Code imports or uses re module.

human_scored_dimensions.description: Regex handles general input rather than one example string.
